## Pull request overview

Implements a centralized, kernel-level API Registry service and plugin, aligned with the ObjectStack microkernel architecture, plus protocol-level typing updates and documentation.

**Changes:**
- Extends the spec API registry schema with input types and clarifies responsibility boundaries for schema resolution.
- Adds an `ApiRegistry` core service with conflict resolution, indexing, and discovery APIs, and exposes it via a kernel plugin (`createApiRegistryPlugin`) and the core package exports.
- Provides comprehensive tests, documentation (`API_REGISTRY.md`), and executable examples (`api-registry-example.ts`) demonstrating registration, discovery, conflict strategies, and multi-protocol usage.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/spec/src/api/registry.zod.ts` | Adds Zod `z.input`-based input types for responses/entries and expands documentation to clarify that schema resolution is delegated to downstream tools, keeping the registry protocol lightweight. |
| `packages/core/src/index.ts` | Re-exports the new `ApiRegistry` service and `createApiRegistryPlugin`, making them part of the core public API surface. |
| `packages/core/src/api-registry.ts` | Introduces the `ApiRegistry` service implementation with Zod-based validation, route conflict strategies, safety-guarded clearing, indexing by type/status/tags, and registry snapshot/statistics APIs. |
| `packages/core/src/api-registry.test.ts` | Adds a focused Vitest suite validating construction, registration/unregistration, route conflict policies, discovery/indexing behavior, stats, multi-protocol support, and environment-guarded `clear()`. |
| `packages/core/src/api-registry-plugin.ts` | Implements `createApiRegistryPlugin` to instantiate and register a shared `ApiRegistry` service in the kernel service registry with configurable conflict strategy and versioning. |
| `packages/core/src/api-registry-plugin.test.ts` | Adds integration tests ensuring the plugin registers the service, works across multiple plugins, respects conflict policies, shares a single registry instance, and participates correctly in the kernel lifecycle. |
| `packages/core/examples/api-registry-example.ts` | Provides end-to-end usage examples showing basic registration, multi-plugin discovery, conflict resolution, custom protocol metadata (WebSocket), and dynamic ObjectQL schema references. |
| `packages/core/API_REGISTRY.md` | Documents the API Registry architecture, configuration, RBAC integration, dynamic schema linking, protocol-specific configuration, public methods, test commands, and links to related specs and tests. |
</details>
